kaart.over: Uit Evolving Skies, de bekende 'Eevee-set' uit 2021 vol V- en VMAX-kaarten van Eeveelutions. Hier is Flareon reusachtig groot geworden, met een extra dikke vuurkraag.

quotes: Elk vuur begint met één vonk. Wat ga jij vandaag aansteken?
The best way out is always through.
On my business card, I am a corporate president. In my mind, I am a game developer. But in my heart, I am a gamer.
We do not need magic to transform our world, we carry all the power we need inside ourselves already.
I've failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.
I've learned that 100 percent of the shots you don't take don't go in the net.
